capture.kind: Stills and loop: SceneKit studio renderer of the MartyGraphics solid engine (2x supersampling, bloom off, exposure -0.3). Hero: GPU path tracing with Metal ray tracing (MartyGraphicsPathTracer) through the MartySolidRT snapshot adapter. Not screenshots, not hand-edited, not AI-generated images.
capture.verify: 23 closed parts, 432776 triangles; LP parts turn at N1, HP parts at N2 = 3 x N1 (measured equals authored); coaxial over 24 sampled angles (max 3.4e-13 mm); no interference. Clearance re-checked at f75f540b165a49edbafa82b136958a9ebaddc1b2 with the lower-bound check: smallest lower bound 4.52 mm (fan to nacelle: 5 mm minus the 0.48 mm dip of a nacelle facet); every rotor's lower bound is at least 4.52 mm.

loopVideo.seam: LP spool one turn, HP spool three turns and a periodic camera, so the frame after the last equals frame 0

review.visual: Every artifact inspected: capped cut faces with no holes or z-fighting, clean silhouettes, labels on their parts, title clear of the model.
review.limits: Schematic teaching model, not a real or validated engine design and not based on any manufacturer's engine. No air flow, pressure, temperature or thrust is simulated. Clearance is a true lower bound (4.52 mm at the fan tips): the 1 mm grid only decides where to look; exact distances between inward-grown projected triangles give the bound. Shafts are colour coded (anodised blue LP, orange HP) for teaching.
review.rerenderCheck: At f75f540b165a49edbafa82b136958a9ebaddc1b2 the exporter's hero-snapshot.json (posed geometry, camera and materials) is byte-identical to the main capture's, so the geometry is unchanged and the path-traced hero is unaffected (the path tracer is seeded and unchanged). Re-rendered labelled and hero stills differ from the main capture only by SceneKit run-to-run noise (at most 5 to 6 of 255 levels on under 1% of pixels, none above 8), so the committed labelled.png and turbofan-loop.gif were kept.
